v1Foundation.finding: The four reused tables exist, but V1 through V19 contain no ENABLE RLS, FORCE RLS or tenant policy for them. V20 remains the only later schema-hardening owner.

serviceTenantRegistry.rule: Dispatcher tenant enumeration occurs only here, outside the protected hris_performance tables.

safeDispatcherPrecedent.reuseRule: Reuse the pattern, not the HRM class: enumerate ACTIVE sys_service_tenants outside protected tables, open one transaction per tenant, verify transaction-local dwp.tenant_id, then claim and finish only that tenant's rows. These HRM files remain read-only.

closedGapSet.finding: claim scans and updates prf_outbox_events across tenants; completion and failure omit tenant predicates; existing tests use owner or superuser connections and cannot prove FORCE RLS behavior.
closedGapSet.requiredResolution: ACTIVE tenant enumeration outside protected tables plus tenant-scoped claim, completion, failure, quarantine and replay under real NOBYPASSRLS non-owner PostgreSQL role.

closedGapSet.finding: Eight transactional PerformanceCycleService entry points filter tenant_id but never establish transaction-local dwp.tenant_id.
closedGapSet.requiredResolution: After canonical authority succeeds and before any V1 table read or write, verify SET LOCAL dwp.tenant_id once in the same transaction.

tenantTransactionContract.statement: SELECT set_config('dwp.tenant_id', CAST(:tenantId AS VARCHAR), TRUE)
tenantTransactionContract.missingContextRule: A protected-table read returns zero rows and a protected-table write affects zero rows or fails closed; it never falls back to cross-tenant access.
tenantTransactionContract.differentTenantRule: A context for tenant A cannot read, claim, complete, fail, quarantine, replay or mutate tenant B rows even when IDs are known.

dispatcherContract.tenantEnumerator: SELECT tenant_id FROM public.sys_service_tenants WHERE lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY tenant_id
dispatcherContract.claimSignature: claim(long tenantId, String workerId, int batchSize, Duration visibilityLease, Set<String> supportedAggregateTypes)
dispatcherContract.claimTimeEligibilityLock: Inside the same claim transaction and before tenant binding or protected-table access, SELECT tenant_id FROM public.sys_service_tenants WHERE tenant_id = :tenantId AND lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' FOR SHARE; no matching row returns zero claims, and the lock is held through claim commit.
dispatcherContract.claimPredicate: candidate.tenant_id = :tenantId after the same transaction has acquired the ACTIVE sys_service_tenants row lock
dispatcherContract.batchRule: The worker never claims more than its configured total batch size in one handoff pass; remaining capacity is carried across tenants in registry order.
dispatcherContract.outcomeRule: markDelivered and markFailed bind event.tenantId and match both tenant_id and event_id plus delivery attempt in the same transaction.
dispatcherContract.replayRule: releaseQuarantined binds the authenticated actor tenant and matches tenant_id plus event_id before updating; audit does not widen protected-table authority.
dispatcherContract.inactiveTenantRule: PROVISIONING, SUSPENDED and RETIRED tenants are never scheduled or claimed; an ACTIVE enumeration result is only a candidate and claim-time locked revalidation is authoritative.
dispatcherContract.emptyRegistryRule: No active tenant means zero protected-table call and zero delivery.

runtimeRoleContract.runtimeRole: a dedicated application-test role distinct from the migration owner and every protected-table owner

migrationAndRoutineOwner.fixtureIdentity: a dedicated migration-owner test role, never the Testcontainers postgres superuser

fixtureDdlPerProtectedTable: ALTER TABLE <exact_protected_table> ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE <exact_protected_table> FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY <test_policy> ON <exact_protected_table> USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('dwp.tenant_id', TRUE), '')::BIGINT) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('dwp.tenant_id', TRUE), '')::BIGINT)

realPostgres: The two package-local PostgreSQL tests migrate Performance V1 through V19, transfer the exact four table owners and the two relevant V2/V3 SECURITY DEFINER routine owners away from Testcontainers postgres to a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migration-owner fixture role, then install ENABLE plus FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY with identical USING and WITH CHECK policies on the four tables. The PostgreSQL fixture asserts pg_class.relrowsecurity and relforcerowsecurity for all four tables, both role attributes, both SECURITY DEFINER routine owners and prosecdef flags, and revoked direct runtime EXECUTE before functional assertions; missing or wrong tenant context cannot gain a protected-table read or trigger-side effect, while same-tenant runtime trigger paths remain functional.
No context and wrong context cannot read or mutate protected rows.
ACTIVE tenants are enumerated outside protected tables and two tenants are claimed in separate tenant-scoped transactions without mixing.
If a tenant is enumerated ACTIVE but a SUSPENDED or RETIRED transition commits before its claim-time eligibility lock, the worker claims zero rows for that tenant.
delivered, failed, quarantined and replay transitions remain bound to the event or authenticated tenant.
Performance Cycle read and command paths establish the transaction-local tenant before touching V1 tables.
targetedVerification.rerunPolicy: Run the bounded target group once. If it fails, rerun only the smallest affected test after the corresponding correction; do not run the repository-wide suite.
targetedVerification.databaseUnavailableRule: If Docker or real PostgreSQL is unavailable, the readiness result is BLOCKED and cannot be recorded as PASS.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The direct Java SQL inventory contains exactly seven production files, and the transaction/runtime inventory additionally covers every indirect service, provider, refetch, database-function and trigger path that reaches the four reused V1 tables.
Performance Cycle establishes one verified transaction-local tenant scope after canonical authority and before every V1 table read or write.

The dispatcher enumerates only ACTIVE tenants from public.sys_service_tenants outside protected tables, opens one tenant-scoped claim transaction per tenant, and revalidates ACTIVE under a held row lock immediately before protected-table access.
Claim, delivery, failure, quarantine and replay operations include exact trusted tenant binding and tenant predicates; the configured total batch size is not exceeded.

A real PostgreSQL runtime role that is non-owner, NOSUPERUSER and NOBYPASSRLS plus a distinct NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migration/routine owner prove default deny, same-tenant access, cross-tenant denial and V2/V3 SECURITY DEFINER trigger behavior under actual ENABLE and FORCE RLS policies whose USING and WITH CHECK expressions are identical.
Existing crash rollback, fencing generation, aggregate ordering, retry, quarantine, replay and exactly-once durable record behavior remain unchanged.

Already compliant Compensation Planning including snapshot provider/refetch, Population Freeze, Performance Review, PER-004 and Performance V2/V3 database-function/trigger paths remain source-unchanged and pass bounded regressions or the FORCE-RLS proof.
No migration is authored, V1 through V19 remain byte-identical, V20 remains absent and unreserved, and the test-only policies never ship in production resources.
Only the exact eight backendWritable paths change after a separate reviewed hash-bound token, and PostgreSQL unavailability records BLOCKED rather than PASS.
Admission grants readiness completion only; product authorization v59/Auth V268 central work and the later PER-008 owner packet/V20/module/UI gates remain separate.

requiredNegativeCases: No dwp.tenant_id context exposes or mutates any row from the four protected tables.
Tenant A context cannot read, claim, complete, fail, quarantine or replay tenant B rows even with known identifiers.
A caller-supplied tenant header, payload field, event payload or worker ID cannot override the trusted tenant binding.
PROVISIONING, SUSPENDED and RETIRED registry rows are never scheduled or claimed.
A tenant enumerated while ACTIVE but committed SUSPENDED or RETIRED before claim-time eligibility locking yields zero claims.
A claimed event cannot be marked delivered or failed with a stale delivery attempt or a different tenant.
One handoff pass cannot exceed the configured total batch size across all active tenants.
The dispatcher cannot enumerate tenant IDs from prf_outbox_events or another protected table.
A runtime role that owns the tables, is superuser or has BYPASSRLS cannot satisfy the evidence requirement.
A migration or SECURITY DEFINER routine owner that is superuser or has BYPASSRLS, including the Testcontainers postgres role, cannot satisfy the evidence requirement.
A unit test, H2 test, mock-only test or unavailable PostgreSQL cannot substitute for the real non-BYPASSRLS proof.
Any migration, V20 lease, PER-008 source, route, menu, feature enrollment or unlisted file change invalidates the packet.
